_readme: Cases for render_test.py. Tiers: smoke < standard < lab. 'standard' = 5 images + 5 videos (V10 = 3 clips stitched), the requested set. 'lab' adds sweeps that isolate the quality cause: same prompt and seed, one change each (see 'sweep'). needs = another case whose output becomes image_start. model_match = regexes tried against 'stem name' of the box's models.

cases.name: I01_ghibli_traveler
cases.note: Stylised, wide landscape. Keyframe for V01. Prompt rewritten: bright front light instead of golden-hour backlight.

settings.prompt: Studio Ghibli-style hand-painted anime illustration, clean crisp line art and richly detailed painted backgrounds. Subject: a lone young man seen from behind in a three-quarter angle, messy brown hair, a sword sheathed on his back, a turquoise tunic with a brown belt, standing on top of an old mossy stone wall, fully and evenly lit. Setting: a wide green valley opens in front of him; on the left, far away, a small stone castle on a hill; on the right, below the wall, a village of thatched roofs with a thin line of smoke; straight ahead at eye level a huge snow-capped mountain range under fluffy white cumulus clouds in a bright blue sky, a winding dirt road across the rolling hills. Lighting: bright midday sun from the front-left, no backlight, no silhouette, every part of the character clearly visible. Palette: vivid saturated greens, warm golds, clear blue sky. Bright, well-exposed, evenly lit, crisp focus, high detail, clean sharp edges, vivid natural colours. No text, no watermark.
settings.negative_prompt: blurry, out of focus, low resolution, low contrast, washed out, hazy, foggy, dark, underexposed, muddy colours, deformed face, bad anatomy, extra fingers, distorted proportions, text artefacts, watermark

cases.name: I05_father_braids_hair
cases.note: Pasted. 3D faces: both smiling, sharp eyes, clean background. Keyframe for V05.

settings.prompt: Pixar-style 3D CGI animated film still, medium close-up of a father and his toddler daughter, both smiling warmly with bright open eyes in sharp focus. The father, early thirties, short tousled brown hair, a brown cotton t-shirt, kneels behind his daughter and carefully tries to braid her long silky blonde hair, looking down at his work with a gentle smile. The toddler, about two years old, round rosy cheeks and big blue eyes, wearing light pink pyjamas with tiny stars, sits cross-legged on a pastel rug and smiles toward the camera while holding a small plush doll. A bright, cheerful children's bedroom lit by large daylight windows: pastel striped wallpaper, a wooden toy chest and a bookshelf, the background clean and sharp, not blurred. Smooth stylised character modelling, expressive faces, individually modelled hair strands, soft realistic shadows. Bright, well-exposed, evenly lit, crisp focus, high detail, clean sharp edges, vivid natural colours.
settings.negative_prompt: blurry, out of focus, low resolution, low contrast, washed out, hazy, foggy, dark, underexposed, muddy colours, deformed face, bad anatomy, extra fingers, distorted proportions, text artefacts, watermark

cases.note: Pasted. Photoreal animals; prompt forces real dog anatomy (the old result looked like dog heads on human bodies). Keyframe for V06.

settings.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic photograph inside a yellow New York taxi cab in bright daylight. A black Labrador sits upright on the driver seat like a real dog (natural dog anatomy, dog head and dog body, no human body), wearing a yellow taxi driver cap and aviator sunglasses, a yellow uniform shirt draped over its chest, both front paws resting on the steering wheel. On the front passenger seat sits a golden-retriever-mix dog looking curiously at the driver. Detailed taxi interior with dashboard, fare meter and seatbelt, the city street clearly visible through the windshield. Realistic fur with individual hairs, sharp eyes, natural colours, 35 mm lens. Bright, well-exposed, evenly lit, crisp focus, high detail, clean sharp edges, vivid natural colours.

settings.prompt: Cinematic 3D CGI animation, slow subtle camera drift to the right. The father gently gathers three sections of his daughter's blonde hair and crosses them over each other, then pauses and smiles as a strand slips loose; he glances at his daughter and they both laugh. The toddler sways from side to side, giggles, makes her small doll hop in her hands and smiles at the camera. Both faces stay clearly visible, smiling, with bright eyes in sharp focus. Natural hair physics, soft blinks. Bright, well-exposed, evenly lit, crisp sharp focus, high detail, clean vivid colours, clear air with no haze or mist. Audio: the toddler's soft giggles, the father's low amused hum, quiet fabric rustles, a gentle playful ukulele melody.

settings.prompt: Cinematic live-action video, subtle handheld camera movement inside a moving taxi cab in bright daylight. The black Labrador driver turns its head toward the passenger, panting gently, one paw adjusting on the steering wheel; the aviator sunglasses and cap stay on its dog head. The golden retriever passenger blinks, tilts its head and glances at the driver. Real dog bodies throughout, natural fur motion. City buildings slide past the windows, light and shadow sweep across the dashboard. Bright, well-exposed, evenly lit, crisp sharp focus, high detail, clean vivid colours, clear air with no haze or mist. Audio: engine hum, soft city traffic, a quiet fare-meter tick, a short friendly dog huff.

cases.name: V08_ai_avatar_speaks_15s
cases.note: THE AVATAR: image-to-video from I08, 15 s of speech, 9:16. Listen for lip sync and clarity.

settings.prompt: A realistic AI digital presenter in a brightly lit studio speaks directly to the camera in a fast, energetic tech-influencer tone. He says: "Stop paying twenty dollars a month for every AI tool. Pick an open model, grab a free test key, paste it into your editor, and you're running in minutes. Link in bio." Natural lip sync, subtle head tilts and nods, authentic eye blinks, two quick hand gestures for emphasis, natural breathing. Static camera with a very slight push-in, steady bright lighting on his face. Bright, well-exposed, evenly lit, crisp sharp focus, high detail, clean vivid colours, clear air with no haze or mist. Audio: his clear voice, a quiet upbeat electronic music bed.

cases.name: V10a_blood_story_a_architecture_5s
cases.note: Clip 1 of 3 (architecture): the pasted yawn prompt, then the dive into the vessel. From I10.

settings.prompt: Cinematic 3D animation for children. The toddler slowly yawns, eyelids drooping sleepily. The camera glides toward the toddler's small hand on the blanket; the skin turns softly see-through in a friendly glowing cartoon way, revealing a bright, clearly lit blood vessel. Pale-yellow liquid plasma flows through it carrying round red cells, big white cells and tiny star-shaped platelets. Kid-safe, no gore. Bright, well-exposed, evenly lit, crisp sharp focus, high detail, clean vivid colours, clear air with no haze or mist. Audio: a calm friendly narrator says: "Blood is a river. Plasma carries three kinds of cells." A soft lullaby music box.

cases.name: V10b_blood_story_b_red_cells_5s
cases.note: Clip 2 of 3: red blood cells and what fails without them. From the SAME image I10.

settings.prompt: Cinematic 3D animation for children inside a bright, clearly lit blood vessel. Round smiling cartoon red blood cells float along in single file, each carrying tiny glowing blue oxygen bubbles, and hand them to small cartoon muscle cells that light up happily. A second shot idea: when the red cells are missing, the muscle cells droop and turn grey. Kid-safe, no gore. Bright, well-exposed, evenly lit, crisp sharp focus, high detail, clean vivid colours, clear air with no haze or mist. Audio: a calm friendly narrator says: "Red cells carry oxygen. Without them, no energy." Gentle chimes, a soft heartbeat.

cases.name: V10c_blood_story_c_white_cells_platelets_5s
cases.note: Clip 3 of 3: white cells, platelets, plasma and what fails without each. From the SAME image I10.

settings.prompt: Cinematic 3D animation for children inside the same bright blood vessel. Friendly big white blood cells in little guard uniforms bounce toward a grumpy green germ and pop it with a puff of sparkles; tiny star-shaped platelets stick together to patch a small scrape on the vessel wall; the pale-yellow plasma keeps everything flowing. Kid-safe, no gore. Bright, well-exposed, evenly lit, crisp sharp focus, high detail, clean vivid colours, clear air with no haze or mist. Audio: a calm friendly narrator says: "No white cells, germs win. No platelets, cuts keep bleeding. No plasma, nothing flows." Gentle chimes.

cases.name: V10_blood_story_stitched_15s
cases.note: THE STITCH EXAMPLE: 3 x 5 s clips -> one 15 s kids' blood-biology video (plasma + 3 cell types, and what fails without each). Check the seams at 5 s and 10 s.
